name: City of Shadows
description: Academy founded by Drafna in the Lat-Nam strait.

description_citations.text: "Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the fall of the College of Lat-Nam, Drafna and other Third Path survivors found the City of Shadows in hiding from the Church of Tal.

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Conclave falls to Lord Ith, surviving mages including Jodah and Shannan travel to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: making it the sole remaining school of magic on Terisiare

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Rivalry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vervamon's party visits the apparently abandoned city and suffers terrifying prophetic dreams before leaving.
timeline.quote: The party abandoned the city the next day.

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Dark Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The oncoming Ice Age forces the School of the Unseen to relocate beyond the ice.
timeline.quote: forcing the mages to move the School of the Unseen to a new location

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Surviving Third Path members including Drafna found the City of Shadows on Iwset.
timeline.quote: later founded the City of Shadows on the nearby island of Iwset

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Scattered Third Path mages seek refuge from the Church of Tal after the falls of Terisia City and Lat-Nam, finding it in the City of Shadows and the Conclave.
timeline.quote: the Third Path was left without a base of operations, its members scattered across Terisiare

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Brothers' War the surviving scholars including Drafna leave Lat-Nam and settle in the City of Shadows as a hidden sanctuary.
timeline.quote: There, they settled down to create a hidden sanctuary for mages and scholars.

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "City of Shadows". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vervamon's party spends a night in the City of Shadows and flees after horrific nightmares.
timeline.quote: During their sleep, almost the entire party had horrific nightmares

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "City of Shadows". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen survives undetected through the Dark Age but must abandon the City of Shadows during the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: the School of the Unseen survived undetected into the Ice Age

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Persecution of wizards led to the creation of the City of Shadows and the Conclave of Mages, where they hid.
timeline.quote: Persecution of these magic-using wizards led to the creation of the fabled City of Shadows in the east and the Conclave of Mages in the west

citation.text: "The Dark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ith leaves on his own; Jodah and Sima take the remaining wizards from the destroyed Conclave to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: Ith decides to leave and be on his own

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR
